title: Wider Student Experience — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

paras: At WCBT, your education extends into clubs, activities, events, and a supportive community that helps you build skills, friendships, and confidence.
Premises of Nidi Secondary School & Indreni Campus

blocks.heading: Learn, build, and belong
paras: Join a vibrant campus where technology enthusiasts and future educators collaborate, compete, and grow together.

blocks.heading: A connected learning community
paras: WCBT operates alongside established partner institutions, giving students access to shared facilities, faculty, and a broader academic network in Eastern Nepal.
bullets: Access to a wide student and alumni network
